usage: agentbreeder list [-h] [--state-dir STATE_DIR] [--json] [--stack DIR]
                         [--environment ENVIRONMENT] [--all]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --state-dir STATE_DIR
  --json
  --stack DIR           Use the operator config and state that `services up`
                        wrote for DIR
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
                        With --stack: the stack environment
  --all                 Also list every stack's deployments under
                        ~/.agentbreeder/stacks (AGENTBREEDER_STACKS_DIR),
                        read-only; stacks it cannot read are reported
